author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Why do so many graphics describing guns, including in MythBusters, show bullets in flight with the case and primer still attached? Any tips for searching the RPF (Replica Prop Forum)? In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers these questions from Tested members tueswednesday and Shakes_The_Clone, whom we thank for their support! Do you accept Adam's argument about simplifying concepts for the sake of general understanding?
